latest_month_store_summary.purpose: Show which like-for-like branches drove the latest monthly result.
latest_month_store_summary.query:
EVALUATE
VAR LatestMonth =
    CALCULATE(
        MAX('MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no])
    )
RETURN
TOPN(
    15,
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
        'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no],
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({LatestMonth}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month]),
        "net revenue CURRENT", [net revenue CURRENT],
        "net revenue PAST", [net revenue PAST],
        "revenue Growth", [revenue Growth],
        "revenue growth %", [revenue growth %],
        "net qty CURRENT", [net qty CURRENT],
        "net qty PAST", [net qty PAST],
        "QTY Growth", [QTY Growth],
        "QTY GROWTH %", [QTY GROWTH %],
        "net bills CURRENT", [net bills CURRENT],
        "bills growth", [bills growth],
        "bills growth %", [bills growth %],
        "retail price current year", [retail price current year],
        "retail price past year", [retail price past year],
        "RETAIL PRICE GROWTH", [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH],
        "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR],
        "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR],
        "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]
    ),
    [net revenue CURRENT], DESC
)

latest_month_division_breakdown.purpose: Identify the main division-level contributors within the latest comparable month.
latest_month_division_breakdown.query:
EVALUATE
VAR LatestMonthInScope =
    CALCULATE(
        MAX('MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no])
    )
VAR DivisionTable =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
            'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[division_name],
            "net revenue CURRENT", [net revenue CURRENT],
            "net revenue PAST", [net revenue PAST],
            "revenue Growth", [revenue Growth],
            "revenue growth %", [revenue growth %],
            "net qty CURRENT", [net qty CURRENT],
            "net qty PAST", [net qty PAST],
            "QTY Growth", [QTY Growth],
            "QTY GROWTH %", [QTY GROWTH %],
            "net bills CURRENT", [net bills CURRENT],
            "bills growth", [bills growth],
            "bills growth %", [bills growth %],
            "retail price current year", [retail price current year],
            "retail price past year", [retail price past year],
            "RETAIL PRICE GROWTH", [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH],
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR],
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR],
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]
        ),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({"CFH014","CFH017","CFH018","CFH021"}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]),
        TREATAS({LatestMonthInScope}, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month])
    )
RETURN
TOPN(
    15,
    ADDCOLUMNS(
        DivisionTable,
        "__SortAbsRevenueGrowth", ABS([revenue Growth])
    ),
    [__SortAbsRevenueGrowth], DESC,
    'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[division_name], ASC
)

latest_month_category_movers.purpose: Surface the biggest category gains and declines in the latest comparable month.
latest_month_category_movers.query:
EVALUATE
VAR __LatestMonth =
    CALCULATE(
        MAX ( 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month] ),
        TREATAS ( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no] ),
        TREATAS ( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no] ),
        TREATAS ( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no] ),
        TREATAS ( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] )
    )
VAR __Base =
    CALCULATETABLE (
        SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
            'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[special_product_group_name],
            "net revenue CURRENT", [net revenue CURRENT],
            "net revenue PAST", [net revenue PAST],
            "revenue Growth", [revenue Growth],
            "revenue growth %", [revenue growth %],
            "net qty CURRENT", [net qty CURRENT],
            "net qty PAST", [net qty PAST],
            "QTY Growth", [QTY Growth],
            "QTY GROWTH %", [QTY GROWTH %],
            "net bills CURRENT", [net bills CURRENT],
            "bills growth", [bills growth],
            "bills growth %", [bills growth %],
            "retail price current year", [retail price current year],
            "retail price past year", [retail price past year],
            "RETAIL PRICE GROWTH", [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH],
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR],
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR],
            "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]
        ),
        TREATAS ( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no] ),
        TREATAS ( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no] ),
        TREATAS ( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'CAT_TABLE'[store_no] ),
        TREATAS ( { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" }, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no] ),
        TREATAS ( { __LatestMonth }, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month] ),
        TREATAS ( { __LatestMonth }, 'CAT_TABLE'[month] ),
        TREATAS ( { __LatestMonth }, 'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[month] ),
        TREATAS ( { __LatestMonth }, 'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[month] )
    )
VAR __TopGains =
    TOPN ( 7, __Base, [revenue Growth], DESC, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[special_product_group_name], ASC )
VAR __TopDeclines =
    TOPN ( 7, __Base, [revenue Growth], ASC, 'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[special_product_group_name], ASC )
RETURN
TOPN (
    14,
    DISTINCT ( UNION ( __TopGains, __TopDeclines ) ),
    [revenue Growth], DESC,
    'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[special_product_group_name], ASC
)

latest_daily_transactions_branch.purpose: Add current-period branch transaction context from the daily table without using it for year-on-year comparison.
latest_daily_transactions_branch.query:
EVALUATE
VAR LatestValidDate =
    MAXX(
        FILTER(
            SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
                'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[TY_DATE],
                "MaxDateValue", MAX('rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[max_date]),
                "DailyLocBills", MAX('rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_BILLS])
            ),
            'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[TY_DATE] <= [MaxDateValue]
                && NOT ISBLANK([DailyLocBills])
        ),
        'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[TY_DATE]
    )
RETURN
TOPN(
    15,
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
        'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_CODE],
        TREATAS({ LatestValidDate }, 'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[TY_DATE]),
        "Transactions",
            SUMX(
                VALUES('rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[TY_DATE]),
                CALCULATE(MAX('rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_BILLS]))
            )
    ),
    [Transactions], DESC
)
